derivation: from the same as H840 (אֲשַׂרְאֵל); right toward God;

occurrences.text: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.
